other_failure_modes.description: The agent calculates historical target statistics (mean, std) over the entire training period and merges them back onto the training set. In a time series problem, this means early training rows receive features calculated using future target values, violating temporal causality and risking overfitting.

summary: The agent provides a robust and highly sophisticated solution utilizing advanced time-series feature engineering, multiple GBDT models, and a PyTorch ResNet, correctly combined via an optimized ensemble. However, it computes categorical target statistics over the entire training set which introduces temporal target leakage into early training rows. Furthermore, stochastic models are trained only once, and only a single metric is used for evaluation.
